; let license = license_projection (id , legs , license . as_ref ()) ? ; let settlement = match (id . family . as_str () , settlement) { ("Accept" , Some (pn_records :: SettlementReferences :: Accept { settles })) if valid_id (settles) => { array ([text ("Accept") , identifier (settles)]) } ("Ratify" , Some (pn_records :: SettlementReferences :: Ratify { settles , accepts })) if valid_id (settles) && valid_id (accepts) => { array ([text ("Ratify") , identifier (settles) , identifier (accepts)]) } ("Accept" | "Ratify" , _) => return Err (ProfileError :: Representation) , (_ , None) => Value :: Null , _ => return Err (ProfileError :: Representation) , } ; let legs = legs . iter () . map (| leg | { Ok (array ([text (role (leg . id . role)) , reference (& leg . source) ? , reference (& leg . target) ? ,])) }) . collect :: < Result < Vec < _ > , ProfileError > > () ? ; let value = array ([identifier (id) , text (match layout { Layout :: Binary => "binary" , Layout :: Paired => "paired" , }) , array (legs) , values , license , array (asserted_parents . iter () . map (identifier)) , array ([]) , settlement , text (match content { ContentRequest :: FullEmpty => "full-empty" , ContentRequest :: Full => "full" , ContentRequest :: Reduced => "reduced" , }) , text (match dependency { DependencyRequest :: FullEmpty => "full-empty" , DependencyRequest :: Full => "full" , DependencyRequest :: Tombstoned => "tombstoned" , }) ,]) ; if value . canonical_len () > 1_048_576 { return Err (ProfileError :: Bound) ; } Ok (value) }
review.item_premise: Public body encodings and computed public commitments record all arguments and results. Secret openings remain owned carriers; only the existing profile recipe publishes its final residue. Unopened digests establish no proposal relation.
